listen_addr.description: IP address to bind the server to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all IPv4 interfaces, :: for all IPv6, or a specific address.

listen_port.description: UDP port to listen on for incoming NetStream/NetFlow/sFlow messages.

interface.description: Network interface to bind to (e.g., eth0). Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

enable_ipv6.description: Enable listening on IPv6 (if supported by the system).

max_message_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of an incoming message to accept. Larger messages are dropped.

workers.description: Number of worker threads for message processing.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Options: debug, info, warn, error, fatal.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the netconsd process.

enable_syslog.description: If true, log to syslog instead of a file.

log_file.description: Path to the log file (used only if enable_syslog = false).

output_format.description: Format for output files. Options: json, plain, syslog.

output_dir.description: Directory where output files (e.g., plain logs) are written.

enable_rate_limit.description: Enable per-source rate limiting to protect against flooding.

rate_limit_max.description: Maximum messages per second allowed per source IP (0 = no limit).

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum burst size (messages) before rate limiting kicks in.

drop_duplicates.description: Drop duplicate messages (same content from same source within duplicate_window).

duplicate_window.description: Time window (in seconds) to detect duplicate messages.

persist_state.description: Persist duplicate cache and rate-limit state to disk across restarts.

state_file.description: Path to the state file (used only if persist_state = true).

allowed_sources.description: List of allowed source IP/CIDR ranges. Leave empty to allow all.

items.description: CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24) or single IP address (e.g., 10.0.0.5).

blocked_sources.description: List of blocked source IP/CIDR ranges. Leave empty to block none.

items.description: CIDR notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/8) or single IP address (e.g., 192.168.99.1).
